name: 2 · Poolside Panic
rule_text: Water needs Lily Rafts. A tide pulse delivers 75 sun every 28 seconds.

levels.title: 2-01 · Water You Doing
levels.briefing: Water needs Lily Rafts. A tide pulse delivers 75 sun every 28 seconds. Establish economy and cover all five lanes.
levels.joke: The welcome mat says hello, not all-you-can-eat. No diving, except the guy who ignored the sign. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns.

levels.title: 2-02 · Raft Before Reason
levels.briefing: Water needs Lily Rafts. A tide pulse delivers 75 sun every 28 seconds. Build sun production before doubling your shooters.
levels.joke: Sunlight remains free. The zombie subscription is harder to cancel. The pool filter is reconsidering its career. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns.

levels.title: 2-03 · The Deep End
levels.briefing: Water needs Lily Rafts. A tide pulse delivers 75 sun every 28 seconds. A new specialist joins the queue. Read its almanac counter before starting.
levels.joke: Local traffic cone promoted to middle management. The lifeguard whistle is decorative, apparently.

levels.title: 2-04 · Certified Lifeguard
levels.briefing: Water needs Lily Rafts. A tide pulse delivers 75 sun every 28 seconds. A new specialist joins the queue. Read its almanac counter before starting.
levels.joke: The doctor recommends more brains. Seek a second opinion. The shallow end has surprisingly deep staffing issues. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns.

levels.title: 2-05 · Fishy Business
levels.briefing: Water needs Lily Rafts. A tide pulse delivers 75 sun every 28 seconds. A new specialist joins the queue. Read its almanac counter before starting.
levels.joke: Your delivery is three lanes away and marked delivered. A rubber duck has filed the only useful incident report. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns.

levels.title: 2-06 · No Splashing the Sunbuds
levels.briefing: Water needs Lily Rafts. A tide pulse delivers 75 sun every 28 seconds. Lose no more than 3 plants to attacks or shoveling. Single-use plants do not count.
levels.joke: The roots have formed a union. Please keep them alive. The pool filter is reconsidering its career. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns.

levels.title: 2-07 · Twenty-Two Floating Decisions
levels.briefing: Water needs Lily Rafts. A tide pulse delivers 75 sun every 28 seconds. Win with at most 22 planting actions, including grafts and rafts.
levels.joke: Twenty plants. Infinite unsolicited gardening opinions. No diving, except the guy who ignored the sign. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns.

levels.title: 2-08 · Lane Rope Optional
levels.briefing: Water needs Lily Rafts. A tide pulse delivers 75 sun every 28 seconds. A new specialist joins the queue. Read its almanac counter before starting.
levels.joke: Turn signals are apparently a living-person feature. The lifeguard whistle is decorative, apparently. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns.

levels.title: 2-09 · Solar Pool Heater
levels.briefing: Water needs Lily Rafts. A tide pulse delivers 75 sun every 28 seconds. Hold 3500 unspent sun and clear all waves. Collection continues after the last zombie.
levels.joke: Four thousand sun in savings. Still cannot afford a garden shed. The shallow end has surprisingly deep staffing issues. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns.

levels.title: 2-10 · Adults Swim Last
levels.briefing: Water needs Lily Rafts. A tide pulse delivers 75 sun every 28 seconds. No mowers. Any breach fails the mission.
levels.joke: The mowers have requested a mental-health day. A rubber duck has filed the only useful incident report. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns.

levels.title: 2-11 · Diving for Complaints
levels.briefing: Water needs Lily Rafts. A tide pulse delivers 75 sun every 28 seconds. Clear the fast waves within 330 seconds.
levels.joke: An internship with excellent exposure and no pulse. No diving, except the guy who ignored the sign. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns.

levels.title: 2-12 · Poolside Buffet
levels.briefing: Water needs Lily Rafts. A tide pulse delivers 75 sun every 28 seconds. The supplied seed menu is fixed. Supplies are borrowed even if not yet unlocked.
levels.joke: The chef insists the menu is a tactical constraint. The lifeguard whistle is decorative, apparently.

levels.title: 2-13 · Fast Lane Snorkel
levels.briefing: Water needs Lily Rafts. A tide pulse delivers 75 sun every 28 seconds. Cover the specialist wave; avoid relying on a single front wall.
levels.joke: This wave has read the terms and conditions. You have not. The pool filter is reconsidering its career. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns.

levels.title: 2-14 · Island Gardening
levels.briefing: Water needs Lily Rafts. A tide pulse delivers 75 sun every 28 seconds. Dark crossed tiles cannot be planted. Zombies still travel through them.
levels.joke: These tiles are reserved for a future parking lot. The pool filter is reconsidering its career. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air.

levels.title: 2-15 · Grafted Water Lilies
levels.briefing: Water needs Lily Rafts. A tide pulse delivers 75 sun every 28 seconds. Create at least 2 grafts and clear the waves. Same-plant twin hybrids count too.
levels.joke: Botany: now with legally questionable welding. A rubber duck has filed the only useful incident report.

levels.title: 2-16 · Depth Charge Tuesday
levels.briefing: Water needs Lily Rafts. A tide pulse delivers 75 sun every 28 seconds. No plants or seeds required. Click a board tile to fire a free recharging area cannon.
levels.joke: No plants today. The salad has authorized artillery. No diving, except the guy who ignored the sign.

levels.title: 2-17 · Five Floaters Maximum
levels.briefing: Water needs Lily Rafts. A tide pulse delivers 75 sun every 28 seconds. Lose no more than 5 plants. Transformations and deliberate single-use plants are exempt.
levels.joke: Five losses are a tragedy. Six are a failed level. The shallow end has surprisingly deep staffing issues. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 2-18 · Lights Out at the Lido
levels.briefing: Water needs Lily Rafts. A tide pulse delivers 75 sun every 28 seconds. No sky sun. Start from the supplied savings and plant your own economy.
levels.joke: Solar power at night: accounting would like a word. The lifeguard whistle is decorative, apparently.

levels.title: 2-19 · Raft Rationing
levels.briefing: Water needs Lily Rafts. A tide pulse delivers 75 sun every 28 seconds. Fixed five-seed deck (graft two Pod Shooters into a Twin Pod for double fire) and a total limit of 24 planting actions.
levels.joke: The seeds were packed by a minimalist. A rubber duck has filed the only useful incident report.

levels.title: 2-20 · Bucket and Spade
levels.briefing: Water needs Lily Rafts. A tide pulse delivers 75 sun every 28 seconds. Armor soaks projectiles. Save explosives for tightly grouped helmets.
levels.joke: Buckets protect brains, not fragile workplace morale. The shallow end has surprisingly deep staffing issues. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 2-21 · Save the Lifeguard Chair
levels.briefing: Water needs Lily Rafts. A tide pulse delivers 75 sun every 28 seconds. No planting. A mature garden is provided. Protect it; click a damaged plant for a free 1200-HP repair every 3 seconds. Crafted tools are optional.
levels.joke: The garden is already planted. Your job description says keep it that way. No diving, except the guy who ignored the sign.

levels.title: 2-22 · Four Thousand Sunblock
levels.briefing: Water needs Lily Rafts. A tide pulse delivers 75 sun every 28 seconds. Collect a total of 4000 sun in this battle. Spending does not reduce this total.
levels.joke: Collect 4000 sun. Do not stare directly at the counter. The pool filter is reconsidering its career. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 2-23 · Interns Overboard
levels.briefing: Water needs Lily Rafts. A tide pulse delivers 75 sun every 28 seconds. Summoners and small runners require rear coverage, not just one front tank.
levels.joke: Fresh interns have arrived. Their onboarding is your problem. The lifeguard whistle is decorative, apparently. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 2-24 · Everyone Out of the Pool
levels.briefing: Water needs Lily Rafts. A tide pulse delivers 75 sun every 28 seconds. Long mixed assault. Pace your economy: the waves never stop being polite about it.
levels.joke: The committee has decided to attack simultaneously. The shallow end has surprisingly deep staffing issues. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 2-25 · Granite Makes a Splash
levels.briefing: Water needs Lily Rafts. A tide pulse delivers 75 sun every 28 seconds. Two giant arrivals with a rebuilding window. Counter its special ability, then clear the field.
levels.joke: The giant brought a club. The homeowners association brought a fine. A rubber duck has filed the only useful incident report. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.
